description: A cluster of outlined triangular play shapes points alternately left and right. Several triangles join through crossing diagonal strokes at the centre, while three detached triangles surround the connected motif.
A front-facing camera has a broad rounded body, a raised central viewfinder housing, and a small shutter button at the upper left. Two concentric circles form the prominent central lens.
A front-facing camera has a rounded rectangular body and a raised central housing with smoothly sloping shoulders. One large circular lens sits in the middle beneath the housing.
A front-facing camera has a wide rounded body and a raised central housing with angled shoulders. A large circular lens contains a short curved reflection at its upper left.
An upward-pointing outlined triangle sits above a separate shallow horizontal outlined bar. The two centred parts share approximately the same width and are separated by a clear gap.
A large outlined right-pointing triangle stands beside a tall narrow outlined bar on its right. The two separated parts align vertically to form a single skip-forward control symbol.
A circular head at the right connects to long horizontal trails extending left from its top and bottom. Shorter detached dashes and a middle trail complete the motion motif.
A front-facing Gungan head has two tall oval eyes, a broad muzzle with a curved smile, and a short lower mouth mark. Long tapered ears hang beside the face with horizontal marks near their ends.
A wide rounded speech bubble has a pointed tail descending from its lower left. Four short horizontal text strokes sit in two staggered rows near the bottom of the otherwise open bubble.
A circular sun is surrounded by eight detached straight rays arranged evenly around its centre. Horizontal, vertical, and diagonal rays form a balanced radial silhouette around the open disc.
An open circle sits on the right beside three detached horizontal rays stacked at the left. The middle ray reaches farther left than the upper and lower rays.
An open circular disc sits to the right of two detached, nested curved rays. Both arcs bow outward to the left and extend above and below the disc.
A large upright disc with a circular centre hole rises behind a low rounded player body. The front has a horizontal slot, and two short feet project beneath the body.
